Overview

Sundsvall is a city in Västernorrland with a population of 99,000. A northern Swedish city known for its stone architecture, pulp and paper industry, and winter sports. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
